content: Womu ɡe Dɑfidi u wom kowobun wiruɡii kuɑ. Bɑ ɡu kuɑwɑ kɑ dɔkɔ te tɑ sɑ̃ɑre nɡe kpɑrukoɡiru ɡe ɡɑ sumɔ dɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑru ɡɑrun wɔllɔ. Dɑfidi u womu ɡe kuɑwɑ sɑnɑm mɛ Filisitibɑ bɑ nùn mwɑ bɑ nɛni Gɑtiɔ. Ge wee.

content.text: Gusunɔ, ɑ nɛn wɔnwɔndu wɑɑwo,
domi tɔn dɑbirɑ tɑ mɑn buku buku mɔ̀.
Tɑ kɑ mɑn tɑbu mɔ̀,
mɑ tɑ mɑn nɔni sɔ̃ɔmɔ tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere.
Nɛn yibɛrɛ be, bɑ dɑbi,
bɑ mɑn buku buku mɔ̀wɑ sɑɑ kpuro,
be, be bɑ kɑ mɑn tɑbu mɔ̀ mi,
bɑ mɑn wɔri bɑ tɑɑre.
Bɛrum mù n mɑn mwɑ.
Wunɑ nɑ rɑ n nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
Yinni, nɑ nun siɑrɑ ɡɑri yi ɑ ɡeruɑn sɔ̃.
Nɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnun bɛrum mɔ,
domi nɑ nun nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
Mbɑ tɔnu u koo kpĩ u mɑn kuɑ.
Tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere bɑ rɑ mɑn ɡɑri kɔsiwɑ,
kpɑ bɑ n mɑn ɡɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃sunu bwisikusimɔ.
Bɑ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ, bɑ mɑn sɑkiriɑmmɛ.
Bɑ nɛn yirɑ kɑsu bu kɑ mɑn hunde wunɑ.
Domi bɑ tɑmɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ yɑ koo bu yɑrɑ.
Yinni, ɑ bu suro kɑ mɔru.
A nɛn yirɑ kpuro swĩi mi nɑ kpikiru dɑ.
A nɛn nɔni yĩresu ɡɑ̃rio wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑru
sɔɔ.
A sin ɡeeru yoruɑ wunɛn tireru sɔɔ.
Gusunɔ, nɑ̀ n nun nɔɔɡiru sue,
nɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ koo biru wurɑ.
Domi nɑ yɛ̃ kɑm kɑm mɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛɡii.
Yinni Gusunɔ, nɑ nun siɑrɑ ɡɑri yi ɑ ɡeruɑn sɔ̃.
Mɛyɑ kon mɑɑ nun tɔmɑ wunɛn ɡɑri yin sɔ̃.
Nɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnun bɛrum mɔ,
domi nɑ nun nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑ tɔnu u koo kpĩ u mɑn kuɑ.
Gusunɔ, kon nɛn nɔɔ mwɛɛru yibiɑ te nɑ nun kuɑ.
Kon yɑ̃kunu ko n kɑ nun siɑrɑ.
Domi ɑ mɑn yɑrɑ sɑɑ ɡɔɔn di.
Mɛyɑ ɑ ǹ derimɔ nɛn nɑɑsu su sokurɑ.
Kpɑ n kpĩ n sĩ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ tɔmbun suunu sɔɔ.
